programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Grant's final case draws near, but that doesn't stop the TAPS team from helping those in need. They head to Mount Joy, Pennsylvania to investigate Bube's Brewery to see if the late owner, Alois Bube, and his deceased family members are still presiding over the lager business. Alois purchased the brewery in 1876 and added on a Victorian hotel to serve his beer and accommodate overnight guests.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Grant's last show draws even closer, but in the meantime the cases keep coming, and this one is very exciting for the whole team; the USS Yorktown in Mt. Pleasant, South Carolina. This is an 872-foot warship, which served in WWII as well as Vietnam and also recovered the Apollo 8 astronauts and space capsule. The USS Yorktown has carried thousands of men and lost more than 140 of them while in battle. Most were pilots who never returned from their missions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For Grant's last episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team decides to stay close to home and investigate Jason and Grant's very own Spalding Inn. GHI investigated their Inn before, but this will be TAPS' first opportunity. The Spalding Inn was originally a summer home named Cherry Hill House that began taking in guests in 1865. It was renamed the Spalding Inn in 1926 when Randall and Anna Spalding took over.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On the first episode back since Grant made his announcement that he wasleaving, TAPS pushes forward focusing on the case on hand. They head to the University of Rhode Island to investigate a Fraternity house that has been experiencing paranormal activity for decades. Purchased in 1936, a former Governor once resided in the house, and there is a claim that his little girl, Abigail, fell to her death there.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to South Carolina, the winner of America's Hometown Ghost Hunters Contest, to investigate the renowned Old City Jail. This historical Jail was the final destination of America's first female serial killer, Lavinia Fisher. It's believed that Lavinia still lingers in the prison and it is up to TAPS to determine if that's true. This site has been around since 1738, when it was first used as a workhouse for slaves and a makeshift hospital for paupers, vagrants, and beggars.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads out on their first case since co-founder Grant Wilson left. This case takes them to New Orleans, Louisiana to investigate what's locally known as the Upstairs Fire at Jimani Lounge. The current owner, Jimmy Jr. was only 12 years old when an arsonist set fire to his father's club on June 24th, 1973. 32 men died trying to escape, but because these men were associated with the gay community, many bodies were never claimed, therefore, victims were never identified. Jimmy Jr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called back to Alexandria, Louisiana to investigate the Alexandria Zoo, where the apparition of the longtime zookeeper and manager, Les has been seen. Les' longtime friend, Bill Hess called in TAPS after many longtime employees and friends noticed strange paranormal activity that reminded them of their dear friend. TAPS also introduces a new member, Ashley to the team and Jason promotes Adam to his new position, Investigator.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate Fort Ontario, a place that was the only location in America to provide sanctuary for Jewish refugees during World War II. Built in 1755, this fort first saw battle during the French and Indian war, and is no stranger to bloodshed. ...and phenomena.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Joliet, Illinois to investigate that Rialto Square Theater. In the 1920's the Rialto Square Theater hosted famous entertainers and vaudeville stars. But in the 1930's an accident took place right outside the theater where a little boy was hit by a car and then later dies inside. People in the theater have since claimed to see the little boy, who they named Kevin, and experienced other eerie paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Claremont, New Hampshire to investigate a former shoe and furniture factory, the Topstone Mill. What was once an abandoned space has now become a restaurant and bar... with frequent visitors from "the other side." Could deceased workers from the 1900's be trying to contact a mother and son team who own the bar? TAPS has surprising evidence that could point in that direction.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Lockport, New York to investigate an underworld of tunnels. It holds a mystery of possible murders, multiple deaths and frightening phenomena. What stories do the spirits of Lockport Caves want to tell? Will TAPS be able to reassure their client that visitors will be safe if they venture on one of the longest underground boat rides in America? Next up, the team travels to Skaneateles, New York to investigate the Fuller House.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Hampton Falls, New Hampshire to investigate the Governor's Mansion, a property Steve has investigated before with a local team. Could this estate's hauntings be connected to a sad secret surrounding a little boy who is believed to have once lived here in the late 1800's? Will TAPS be able to reach this child and find out if he was in fact the hidden legitimate son of State Senator, Warren Brown? Could the State Senator have been behind his murder?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Bowling Green, Kentucky to investigate Western Kentucky University. This University was established in 1906 and has 20,000 students attending. Tamela Smith is the client, and has called TAPS in to figure out if some of the stories that have been passed down over the decades are folklore or truth. There are three main stories that surround the school.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Rochester, New York to investigate the Rochester Public Library's 15 years of claims. There's reason to believe that two deaths associated with the building could be behind the activity. The library wants to go public with the phenomena but only if accurate. Can TAPS find the answer they are looking for and finally let the public in on this library's long-held secret?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS returns to Hartford, Connecticut to investigate the Mark Twain House. With their previous investigation marred by malfunctioning equipment, TAPS is being called back to look into new and frightening claims that could finally uncover who is residing there. Will Samuel Clemens' favorite holiday initiate an appearance from the famous author? Or will his three children try to reach out to TAPS?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Hollywood, California to investigate the infamous Black Dahlia murder at the historic Sowden House. Aspiring actress, Elizabeth Short was nicknamed the Black Dahlia after her brutal murder and the leading suspect of that horrific crime was never convicted. Two people have called in TAPS; the first being the main murder suspects own son, Steve Hodel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Bartonville, Illinois, to investigate Peoria Asylum. The owners are renovating this building and have noticed a lot of paranormal activity since they started their restorations. Built in 1898 and opened in 1902, it is said that 16,000 people died there, from multiple reasons, including, patients killing patients and suicide. The asylum's records hold two key figures; Dr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Cortland, New York to investigate The 1890 House. Industrialist, Chester Wickwire built this home for his family, and even though they have long passed, it's believed by some that the family may still reside here. Michelle, the caretaker, is concerned that the spirits may follow her home. Do the Wickwire's still live in their former home and if so, can TAPS help put Michelle's mind at ease that they mean her no harm?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the oldest operating steamboat in the United States. The boat was built in 1914 and has been used for everything from dances to gambling. Its former Captain Winters was legendary for being somewhat shady. It's claimed that he killed a deckhand named Floyd during an argument when he sent him to do work on the paddle wheel and then ordered full steam ahead, which killed Floyd.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Coventry, Connecticut to investigate the Nathan Hale Homestead. Nathan Hale was an American Patriot who fought in the Revolutionary War and was executed by hanging by the British for being a spy. He was left outside hanging for days to send a message. He was then dumped in an unmarked grave. Now our client, Bev, believes he has come back to his childhood home. His house was built in 1776 and in the 1940's was turned into a museum.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Shreveport, Louisiana to investigate the Shreveport Auditorium, a place that is famous for introducing Elvis to the world. Shreveport Auditorium opened in 1929 and is considered a national landmark. The auditorium's stage has been graced by such stars as Hank Williams and Johnny Cash and is known as the first place Elvis preformed professionally. A statue of Elvis was erected after he passed and that's when the phenomena is said to have begun.
programme.sub-title: The Ghost Hasn't Left the Building

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Little Rock, Arkansas to investigate a personal case at the Jones House and their bungalow next door. Robberies, fires, assault, and murder have all taken place in the old bungalow, dating back to 1898, when Ed Cornish had his wife and two children die 16 hours apart. Then in 2005 Bonnie Wallace, the Jones' neighbor, was murdered by an acquaintance in the bungalow and her husband, Paul died shortly after from illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Liberty, Missouri to investigate the Belvoir Winery; a property that has four buildings that are being renovated to become a retirement facility and winery. These buildings were at one time an orphanage, an old folks home, a hospital, and a nursing home and have seen over 10,000 deaths through the years.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In 1931, Boulder City was built to accommodate the thousands of Hoover Dam workers and their families who inundated the area. Around the same time, the Boulder City Hospital was constructed mainly to care for the injured and dying Hoover Dam workers. Because of dangerous working conditions and hardships, over 100 men died building the Dam, with many of them ending up at the Boulder City Hospital.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Monticello, Arkansas to investigate The Allen Mansion, built in 1906 by a wealthy businessman named Joe Allen. He lived there with his wife and three daughters. One of Joe Allen's daughters, Ladell is believed to have committed suicide in the mansion at the age of 54 years because of her divorce and later losing her son to pneumonia.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Shreveport, Louisiana to investigate two buildings that may share the same paranormal activity. The client, Grayson owns the 1800's era Rendall Building, which is across the street from the second building with activity, the Caddo Parish Courthouse. They are thought to be connected because it's believed that the The Rendall building's basement once acted as a cold storage facility for those who were hanged at the Courthouse.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Scott Township, Pennsylvania to investigate the Pennsylvania Asylum and Testing Lab. This building was originally used as a poor house in the late 1800's and became a mental institution in 1915, followed by an animal testing facility. TAPS will have their hands full as they take on claims of threatening shadows and people being physically accosted.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Hyde Hall in Cooperstown, NY to investigate a cursed family home. George Clark started building Hyde Hall in 1817 with the intension of it being a showplace for Clarke's agricultural empire and to remind him of his childhood in England. George died in 1835 on the southern porch before completion and his son, George Jr., took over the property. This was followed by a contentious relationship between George Jr. and his mother.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Buffalo Naval and Military Park has called upon TAPS to investigate three vessels that all saw gunfire and bloodshed during their time of service. The ships that will be investigated are a cruiser named USS Little Rock (the largest), a destroyer named USS The Sullivans, and a submarine named USS Croaker, (the smallest). USS Little Rock has reported deaths on it.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Octagon Hall was built by Andrew Jackson Caldwell in 1847. Andrew and his wife, Elizabeth helped Confederate Soldiers during the Civil War by setting up a hospital room, where many of the soldiers died. They also built tunnels and passageways where the Confederate Soldiers could hide from the Union Soldiers. Andrew's wife and son died of Typhoid Fever during the war and his daughter, Mary Elizabeth, died when her dress caught on fire in the kitchen and she burned to death.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS has been called to Lucas, Ohio by playwright Mark Jordan to investigate the property on which one of the most gruesome events took place in 1896, The Ceely Rose Murders. Ceely killed her father, brother and lastly, her mother with rat poison because she believed they were keeping her from the love of her life, Guy Berry. Ceely was 23 years at the time, but had a mental capacity of an 8 year old. Mark wrote a play about these murders, which he performs in a barn on the property.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Belle Grove Plantation sits in King George, Virginia. It is now a bed and breakfast, but the plantation played an important role in American History. James Madison, the 4th president, was born here, and John Wilkes Booth crossed through the property after he assassinated President Lincoln. The armed contingent searching for Booth stayed at Belle Grove Plantation the night before they caught and killed him.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to Brunswick, Georgia to investigate Brunswick Old City Hall. Chief Tobe Green has asked the team to investigate reports of paranormal activity that has gone on for years. Construction began in 1889 and by 1890 the top floor was used as the municipal court. In 1890, Officer Robert L. Massey was shot and killed here while trying to arrest a man who was found guilty for a minor offense. Unexplained activity has been reported ever since.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates the abandoned Elizabeth V. Edwards Elementary School in Barnegat, New Jersey. Built in 1930, this was first Barnegat High School until a larger one was built in 1957, turning this into an elementary school. In 1975 the school was renamed Elizabeth V. Edwards. Elizabeth was someone who dedicated her entire life to the education of Barnegat's young people. She passed away in 1965. The school was shut down in 2004.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Client, Rebecca Jordan Gleason has called TAPS back to Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum, in Weston, West Virginia, at a time when they are celebrating their 150th anniversary and Ghost Hunters, their 200th episode. TAPS was here in 2008 and found great evidence. Their parting words to Rebecca were for her to not do anything to stir up more paranormal activity...but that advice was not heeded and the activity has increased.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The prestigious Cincinnati Music Hall has welcomed famous composers and entertainers ranging from Igor Stravinsky and Richard Straus to Ella Fitzgerald and Bruce Springsteen. But it's the "the dead" that have shined a light on this historical building. In 1878 the central hall was first constructed and a year later the north and south halls were added to accommodate the industrial exhibitions that were so popular at the time.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Carthage, Missouri to investigate the Burlingame & Chaffee Opera House. The building has multiple floors and has had various uses over the decades, starting in 1878 when the second floor was an Opera House, the lower level, a hardware store and the basement a mortuary. In the early 1900's the building was sold to Charles E. Turner who owned a carriage and harness company.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Joplin, Missouri to investigate the Holly Hill Estate. The property is comprised of two houses with very different histories. The first house is called Willow Vista, which was built in 1916 and was a private club with ties to the mob. Over the years it was also believed to have been a speakeasy and a brothel. In 1958, a doctor named Donald Patterson bought the Willa Vista and made it into a family home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stay close to home as they investigate two neighboring buildings: Stadium Theatre and Stadium Building in Woonsocket, Rhode Island. Original owner, Arthur Darman constructed the building and the theatre in 1926. His vision for the theatre was to bring live entertainment to those who couldn't afford to travel to New York. The adjacent building was a community hub, which featured doctors' offices, law firms, dentists, and insurance agencies.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Hyde Park, New York to investigate the Culinary Institute of America. Built in the early 1900's the building was originally a seminary for young men looking to become Jesuit priests. It was shut down in 1969 due to diminishing enrollment. The Culinary Institute took over the building two years later.
programme.sub-title: Too Many Apparaitions in the Kitchen

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stays close to home on this investigation as they travel to Newport, Rhode Island to investigate Fort Adams, the largest coastal fortress ever constructed on US soil. This is the second fort built on the site. The original structure was built in 1799 and stood through 1812. The fort was rebuilt from 1824-1857 and could hold 468 cannons, where as the first could only hold 20. Many deaths were reported but had nothing to do with battle but rather, murder, suicide, and illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Bennington, Vermont to investigate Southern Vermont College. Edward Everett was a wealthy man who built his mansion on these grounds between 1911-1914. He was married twice and had 5 children. When he died in 1929 his estimated worth was between $40-$50 million. The legend that students have passed down through the years is that Edward's first wife, Amy, committed suicide, and didn't die of poor health, which was reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the Conrad-Caldwell Castle, the masterpiece built by well-known architect, Arthur Loomis. The house took 3 years to complete and was the symbol of success for the original owner, Theophilus Conrad and his wife, who started out as poor immigrants before working their way up to being wealthy industrialists. The couple lived in this home for ten years, before Mr. Conrad died of a heart attack on the basement stairs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Boston, Massachusetts to investigate the USS Constitution, the oldest commissioned warship still afloat in the world and one that also never lost a battle. She was built in 1794 and decommissioned in 1855, then placed in permanent commission in 1940. Today she holds a crew of 60, but at a peak time, during the War of 1812, she had 450-500 people aboard: including 60 marines, 350-400 sailors, and 50 officers/ship boys.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to North Adams, Massachusetts to investigate Houghton Mansion. It was built in 1897 for North Adams' first Mayor, A.C Houghton. Constructed on the foundation of a previous home, The Houghton Mansion was used for the family and fundraisers. The hauntings are said to have begun in 1914 after a tragic car accident took the lives of A.C Houghton and his daughter. His chauffer was driving and was so overcome with guilt that he took his own life the next day. A week later Mr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Glen Spey, New York to investigate Burn Brae Mansion, which was formerly the summer home of Margaret and Charles Elkin. It was constructed in the early 1900's by Margaret, who was one of seven MacKenzie siblings to build a grand estate in Glen Spey with the money given to her by her father. Several of Charles and Margaret's children passed away young, and their coachman, William attempted suicide on the property, and later died.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out by two clients to investigate the Midwest Railway Preservation Society in Cleveland, Ohio. Built in 1907, this rail yard had over 400 people working there 24/7. Some of the jobs were very dangerous with a number of injuries and deaths taking place over the years, with the brakeman being one of the most dangerous. Sometimes people fell off the tops of the trains and died.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Detroit, Michigan to investigate The Whitney. Originally built in 1890 by lumber baron David Whitney, it was used as a private residence for him and his second wife, Sarah, along with his four children. At the time the house was built he was the wealthiest man in Detroit, and spared no expense in his home, including adding the first personal use elevator, and $400,000 worth of furnishings from two trips to Europe. Mr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Toledo, Ohio to investigate the Toledo Yacht Club. Susan Hurst has called the guys in to investigate the club, which first opened in 1865. A fire destroyed it in 1906 and it was rebuilt in 1908. It became well known during the prohibition era, as bootleggers used the docks to smuggle Canadian booze across Lake Erie.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Steve's hometown of New Bedford, Massachusetts to investigate Fort Taber-Fort Rodman. In the 1770's New Bedford was home to many Colony Pirates and in 1778 the Navy launched a raid on New Bedford on the same spot the fort sits today. Three colonists were killed and New Bedford was burned to the ground.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS stays local as they investigate the Varnum Memorial Armory in East Greenwich, Rhode Island. The armory was built in 1913 by the Varnum Continentals, Inc., a group that works to preserve the Rhode Island military history, and was to be used as a clubhouse and meeting hall for them. There are no reported deaths on the property, but they did hold wakes for soldiers that died during WWI and WWII.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to Valparaiso, Indiana to investigate the Inn at Aberdeen. The house dates back to the 1850's and was purchased by the Ritter family, who were thought to be involved in the Underground Railroad. The house changed ownership over the years until the client, John, purchased it in 1995. Since then reports of paranormal activity have been accumulating.

programme.desc: Winter Wipeout reaches a suitably dramatic finale this week with Winter Wipeout: The Final. And when we say dramatic, we mean dramatic with added snow. The finest contestants from across the series -champions and losing finalists -once again hop on the flight to South America to take on the most arduous and extraordinary snow-clad, foam-padded obstacle course on Earth.

programme.title: Total Wipeout
programme.desc: This is the first 'Celebrity Special' of 'Total Wipeout'. You will see how ten celebrities get wet and repeatedly face tough obstacles in order to win the grand final. However, this time, the winner will give all 10,000 pounds to charity. Celebrities are Kevin Adams, James and Ola Jordan, Luke Bailey, Joe Swash, Kaye Adams, Tim Vine, Carrie Grant, Adele Silva and more.

programme.title: Total Wipeout
programme.desc: This is the first 'Celebrity Special' of the season. Today, Richard Hammond presents an extraordinary game show in which ten celebrities tackle one of television's most extreme obstacle courses to win 10,000 pounds for charity. Celebrities are Dalton Grant, Ricky Groves, Gail Emms, Charlie Stayt, Roxanne Pallett, Simon Day, Brian Belo, Camilla Dallerup, Nicola McLean and Julie Peasgood.

programme.title: Total Wipeout
programme.desc: Richard Hammond presents the annual Total Wipeout trophy-athon where they celebrate the highs, the lows and the biggest splashes from the whole season. The presenter starts with the new 'Best Slip and Trip Award' and will be showing the top five, and the winner for each category. Don't miss this special episode!

programme.title: The Almost Impossible Gameshow
programme.desc: The first episode of the game show in which 50 members of the public compete - with almost no chance of winning at all. Tonight's challenges include Tiny Bike, Dizzy Hurdle and Groin Croissant.

programme.title: Total Wipeout
programme.desc: This is the second 'Celebrity Special' of the season. This time, all of them face 'The Qualifier' and 'The Crash Mountain' before the eliminations begin. programme.title: Total Wipeout
programme.desc: Tonight, twenty brave battlers -including a grave digger, a pet detective and a whisky taster will take on the wintry weirdness. They all have something in common -the wish to return home minus bruising and a cheque for £10,000. Five take on Winter Blunderland but only three contestants will survive it and become tonight's heroes -going through to the ever so chilly Wipeout Zone.

programme.title: Total Wipeout
programme.desc: Stand by for foam-padded action. It's another high-octane, low-pain-threshold edition of crazed knockabout game show Total Wipeout. Richard Hammond, as your host, will be arching an eyebrow at the ludicrous antics of 20 more over-excited contestants, who have thrown caution to the wind on Argentina's famous Total Wipeout course.

programme.title: Total Wipeout
programme.desc: The Winter Blob makes a welcome appearance to send the contestants into orbit whilst Granny's House and the Big Red Balls attempt to send the participants flying. Can Cherry Man John eat enough cherries to make it through? Can Rio the coach driver drive his way to victory or will Mica the Welsh sprint champion become the Winter Wipeout Champion?

programme.title: Total Wipeout
programme.desc: This is the first episode of 'Total Wipeout'! You are about to see crashes, smashes and hilarious mud splashes on the cards as twenty contestants take on one of television's largest and most extreme obstacle courses. They face different games like The Qualifier, The Sweeper, The Dizzy Dummies and the grand final on The Wipeout Zone.

programme.title: Total Wipeout
programme.desc: 10 celebrities will be taking the reindeer-drawn celebrity sleigh to the top of the Qualifier, where Amanda Byram will be waiting with a pithy put-down and a barrel of laughs. From the warmth of the studio Richard Hammond will be commentating on the efforts of musical star Connie Fisher, snowy Olympic hero Eddie The Eagle Edwards and hearthrob boy-band songster Tony Mortimer from E17.

programme.title: Total Wipeout
programme.desc: It's time for 'The Final' of 'Total Wipeout' season 2. During this season, 160 contestants have fallen, bounced and swung to win the prize, but only eight of them could achieve it. Now, these eight winners compete again to win another 10,000 pounds. This time they face games like The Qualifier, The Sweeper, Dizzy Dummies and the grand final on The Wipeout Zone.

programme.title: Total Wipeout
programme.desc: Twenty contestants take on one of television's largest and most extreme obstacle courses in order to win 10,000 pounds and get to 'The Final'.

programme.title: Total Wipeout
programme.desc: Total Wipeout, the biggest, brashest and most exhausting game show on television, is back for more bangs, bumps, and bruises. This episode sees the return of the finalists from across the series as they compete for the ultimate title, 'Champions of Champions'. programme.title: Total Wipeout

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With autumn on the horizon, the seasonal planting of bulbs for spring-flowering begins at Longmeadow. Frances Tophill meets a gardener whose allotment is filled with both traditional and exotic vegetables and Toby Buckland visits The Newt in Somerset to find out about its chequered garden history and to explore its emergence as one of the UK's most exciting gardens.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty creates colourful planting schemes with trailing plants. He also plants out cabbages in the vegetable garden and shares a clever tip for dealing with spent tulips. Toby Buckland revels in the displays of roses at Mount Ephraim Gardens in Kent.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Featuring Ramona Jones, who was diagnosed with autism in her twenties and discovered how she can find her true identity when she's in the garden. Meanwhile, Monty makes some changes to his pots in the Jewel Garden, harvests gooseberries and plants out squash.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: The team are Birmingham-bound for the annual Gardeners' World Live event. Monty Don, Arit Anderson, Adam Frost, Sue Kent, Carol Klein, Joe Swift, Rachel de Thame and Frances Tophill present the best the gardening world has to offer.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With summertime at its peak, Adam plans to extend the season with plants for evening scent and shares the results of his wild meadow turf experiment. In North Yorkshire, Nick Bailey discovers the range of floral beauty of Cornus kousa.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gives a masterclass on rambling, climbing and shrub roses. He also plants out tender annuals in the jewel garden, and with hot, dry summer days ahead, shares tips for water saving and harvesting.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: After an extraordinary season, Monty's orchard has a bountiful harvest of apples and he gives advice on how to pick and store them. Frances Tophill makes a final visit to her shared allotment and joins in with the festivities at their annual show. Adam Frost visits the RHS garden Wisley where he meets the Curator to discuss the effects of summer. Nick Bailey investigates knotweed, one of the most pernicious weeds in the UK, Arit Anderson provides inspiration for colourful late season containers.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As Monty brings in the summer harvest, he gives advice on what to sow to keep the crops coming up to the end of Autumn. Carol Klein visits a woman who is losing her eyesight and gives her recommendations of plants that will be a feast for her senses.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Turkey Monty is dazzled by an extraordinary display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire. Stunning mausoleums were set in vast gardens as places where an earthly king could enter a divine paradise.

programme.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
programme.desc: Monty continues his travels to learn about the art of Japanese stonemasonry and the famous tea ceremonies and their accompanying gardens, before finally taking a lesson in the delicate art of traditional flower arranging.

programme.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don returns to Japan during the fiery blaze of autumn. He visits the three great gardens of Japan to learn how they protect the garden from the coming winter and learns how the Japanese are weaving nature into their concrete urban jungle.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a powerbase of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. In the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.
programme.sub-title: The Veneto, Lucca and The Lakes

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Starting his journey at the sole surviving garden of the 1600s, Levens Hall in Cumbria, Monty sets out to investigate what the gardens of this age would have looked like and what influenced and inspired their creation.

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Monty bases himself at Rousham House in Oxfordshire, designed by one of the first practitioners of the landscape movement, William Kent. It has survived almost unchanged since its completion in 1741.

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Monty Don explores the extraordinary transformations that occurred throughout the 19th century. As a result of an expanding empire, scientific and technological innovation and social change, British gardens became more exotic, more colourful and more widely accessible than ever before.

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his journey through Britain's gardening heritage by looking at how the nation's gardens have evolved over the last hundred years. He looks at the profound effect that two world wars had on the attitude to gardens and gardening.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty shows how to harvest and store potatoes. He also adds late summer colour to the cottage garden and prunes shrub roses. Carol Klein travels to Norfolk to meet Adrian Bloom, a member of a horticultural dynasty.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost shares the progress that's been made in his garden. Frances Tophill heads to the beach to reveal what gardeners can learn from the coastal plants which have evolved to cope with more extreme conditions.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: From giant gooseberries and growing the perfect sweet pea to flamboyant dahlias and plants pollinated by a human hair, this week Monty celebrates the plant passions of some of the extraordinary people featured on the show over the last few years.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don harvests apples, pears and quince and plants indoor bulbs, we meet a Northern Irish daffodil breeder, and Carol Klein travels to Wales to explore the Eupatorium with a passionate gardener who has a rare and spectacular collection.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gives tips on moving plants which are in the wrong place or have outgrown their space, shows how to store chilies and harvests the last of his tomatoes. Rachel de Thame returns to Longmeadow to talk to Monty about her return to health and to plant up pots for spring colour.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With autumn well under way, some plants in the garden need to be brought in under cover. Monty Don makes a start by insulating his greenhouse to provide a winter home for all sorts of tender plants and gives his tips and techniques for ensuring their survival until next year. Carol Klein visits the garden of a tropical plant enthusiast to find out how he protects some of his exotic specimens.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don is at Longmeadow with a host of seasonal jobs to keep his autumn garden looking beautiful for as long as possible, and in the third of her fascinating films about how plants work, Carol Klein investigates the science of stems.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: In the fourth of her films about botany, Carol Klein explores the inner workings of leaves - how they harness the sun's energy and turn it into food. Joe Swift meets Griff Rhys Jones for a private tour of his remarkable garden and discovers what a passionate gardener he is.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty is planning for next summer by sowing a batch of sweet peas. Plus, there's a visit to Ryton Gardens in Warwickshire to find out about their collection of heritage vegetables and how to collect their seeds.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty's thoughts turn to spring when he gives recommendations for bulbs to plant that will thrive in pots. He also shows how to prune summer fruiting raspberries. In Norfolk, Frances Tophill visits a gardener who at 97 still gardens every day.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It's all about the maintenance this week at Longmeadow, as Monty cuts back and divides spring flowering plants. programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty and the team celebrate the wonder of trees and explore the vital role they play in gardens and the wider landscape. Zoe Ball joins Toby Buckland on a visit to a tree project in North London.

programme.desc: Monty and the team are at RHS Rosemoor in Devon to find out about their fruit trees and sedum collection, and Joe visits Scampston Hall, home of a ten-year experiment in naturalistic planting by garden designer Piet Oudolf.

programme.desc: With Halloween approaching, Monty takes stock of his pumpkins and squashes, plants up alpines and shows how to divide a large fern to create new plants. Meanwhile, Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond visit Hever Castle in Kent.

programme.desc: The team celebrate the bounty our gardens have to offer at this time of year as Carol Klein gathers wild blackberries, Monty Don is at Longmeadow, and we join a champion vegetable grower in Yorkshire as he prepares for the biggest show of the season.

programme.title: Derailed
programme.desc: Secret agent Kristoff (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is assigned to escort Galina Konstantin (Laura Elena Harring), a thief in possession of a deadly virus, on a train journey that unluckily falls on his birthday. Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus.

programme.title: JCVD
programme.desc: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery.

programme.title: Legionnaire
programme.desc: When ambitious boxer Alain LeFevre (Jean-Claude Van Damme) refuses to accept a mobster's bribe, he ends up with a price on his head. A marked man, LeFevre takes refuge by enlisting in the French Foreign Legion. After traveling to a remote Moroccan outpost, LeFevre and his regiment suffer repeated attacks at the hands of the Berber rebel army. As he struggles to survive his tenure as a legionnaire, LeFevre dreams of returning to France to find his lady love, Katrina (Ana Sofrenovic).

programme.title: Timecop
programme.desc: When mankind perfects time travel, the government establishes the Time Enforcement Commission to thwart criminal attempts to alter the timeline. Police officer Walker (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is recruited by TEC Cmdr. Matuzak (Bruce McGill), but soon finds his investigation of Senator Aaron McComb (Ron Silver) being thwarted by elements within the government. When Walker's wife, Melissa (Mia Sara), is attacked, he must travel across time to rescue her and save the future.

programme.title: Until Death
programme.desc: Anthony Stowe (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is a drug-addicted detective teetering on the edge. He shows little regard for his fellow cops, ratting out a respected veteran who takes him to task shortly before he's fired. All Stowe cares about is putting away drug-dealing former cop Callahan (Stephen Rea), who is taking over New Orleans' underworld. But Callahan's henchman (Stephen Lord) puts Stowe in a coma, and after he awakens, he realizes it's more important to redeem himself and get off drugs.

programme.title: Affliction
programme.desc: In a small New Hampshire town, washed-up cop Wade Whitehouse (Nick Nolte) has a troubled past, an abusive father (James Coburn), the contempt of his ex-wife (Mary Beth Hurt) and an unimpressive streak as a lawman. When hunting guide Jack Hewitt (Jim True) reports a businessman's accidental death during a hunting trip, Wade believes he has a chance to turn around his life, if he can prove it was murder. Increasingly obsessed, Wade begins to lose his composure during the investigation.

programme.title: Eyes Without a Face
programme.desc: Dr. Génessier (Pierre Brasseur) is riddled with guilt after an accident that he caused disfigures the face of his daughter, the once beautiful Christiane (Edith Scob), who outsiders believe is dead. Dr. Génessier, along with accomplice and laboratory assistant Louise (Alida Valli), kidnaps young women and brings them to the Génessier mansion. After rendering his victims unconscious, Dr. Génessier removes their faces and attempts to graft them on to Christiane's.

programme.title: Half Nelson
programme.desc: Dan Dunne (Ryan Gosling) is a history teacher at a Brooklyn school. Though well-liked by his students and colleagues, he secretly spends his evenings hopping bars and getting high. A female student named Drey (Shareeka Epps) catches him in a drug-induced haze after a basketball game, and the two strike up an unlikely friendship. As Dan struggles with his addiction, he tries to act as a mentor to the girl, whose brother is serving time for dealing drugs.

programme.title: My Dinner With Andre
programme.desc: Old friends Wallace (Wallace Shawn) and Andre (Andre Gregory) haven't seen each another in five years and agree to meet for dinner. Andre, a once well-known theater director, dropped out of the New York scene to travel the world, while Wallace stuck around, finding only mixed success as a playwright. As they sit down to eat, Andre launches into a series of fantastic stories from his time away, and Wallace can't help but notice how different their worldviews have become.

programme.title: Glengarry Glen Ross
programme.desc: When an office full of New York City real estate salesmen is given the news that all but the top two will be fired at the end of the week, the atmosphere begins to heat up. Shelley Levene (Jack Lemmon), who has a sick daughter, does everything in his power to get better leads from his boss, John Williamson (Kevin Spacey), but to no avail. When his coworker Dave Moss (Ed Harris) comes up with a plan to steal the leads, things get complicated for the tough-talking salesmen.

programme.title: Whale Rider
programme.desc: Only males are allowed to ascend to chiefdom in a Maori tribe in New Zealand. This ancient custom is upset when the child selected to be the next chief dies at birth. However his twin sister, Pai (Keisha Castle-Hughes), survives. At age 12, she enlists the help of her grandmother (Vicky Haughton) and the training of her uncle (Grant Roa) to claim her birthright. But to break with convention, she'll have to do the impossible: win over her ultra-traditional grandfather (Rawiri Paratene).

She implores him never to use his magic kick again, and all is well, until Fang arrives to challenge the master.

programme.title: A Fighters Journey

But when Brookins was crowned the Ultimate Fighter after winning the 12th Season UFC Finale, what is fans didn't know is that he was facing a much tougher opponent outside the cage... himself. Drugs and alcohol together with an eating disorder had taken it's toll on Brookins.

programme.title: Shaolin Chastity Kung Fu
programme.desc: After the massacre of a small village, a group of survivors led by Ah Tien are trained by a mysterious monk. They train in the arcane secrets of Tong Zi Kung. Soon they decide to avenge their loved ones against the Nine Devil Gang.

programme.title: Shaolin Chastity Kung Fu
programme.desc: After the massacre of a small village, a group of survivors led by Ah Tien are trained by a mysterious monk. They train in the arcane secrets of Tong Zi Kung. Soon they decide to avenge their loved ones against the Nine Devil Gang.

programme.title: Ninja over the Great Wall
programme.desc: Ninja over the Great Wall takes place in the early nineteen-thirties when China was occupied by the Japanese imperial forces. Wa Chi Keung is a peasant who escaped the mass murder of his village by the Japanese. He joins his master in Beijing shortly before the old man's assassination by ninjas. What follows is a one man war on the Ninjas and Japan top bushido experts.

programme.title: Duel of Karate
programme.desc: Twin baby boys are separated at birth when their kung fu master father and mother are slaughtered by an opposing kung fu clan. The two live separate lives, but fate later throws them into a duel to the death with each other. A master class in kung fu cinema highly recommended. Wall to wall action.

programme.title: Devil's Dynamite aka Robo Vampire 2: Devil's Dynamite
programme.desc: Steve (Tsung Hua) is a gambler getting out of prison and looking to get revenge on Mary (Angela Mao), the crime boss who sent him to the clink. Also on Mary's trail is Alex (Ling Yun), a police officer who has the ability to turn into the silver lame-swaddled hero Shadow Warrior. So, as any sane person would do, Mary hires an evil Taoist priest to create a group of vampire assassins to protect her.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Chuck Sullivan
programme.desc: A 60-plus year veteran of the martial arts, Chuck Sullivan is considered one of the most influential artists in American kenpo karate. As one of the earliest black belts of icon Ed Parker, Sullivan stepped into history in 1961 by developing the first series of instructional films which played a key role in the early stages of promoting kenpo throughout the world.

programme.title: Shaolin Iron Finger aka Renegade Master
programme.desc: Carter Wong stars as a Kung Fu master who uses the "Death Finger" technique. However, he can also use his finger for good as he uses the technique to reset a little boy's broken arm. He also leads an underground resistance force, which worries his mother. When she is kidnapped by the bad guys, it's up to Wong to rescue her. Carter must kill three guys to save mom. Carter's men abandon him because of the killings.

programme.title: Fighting Sticks of Arnis
programme.desc: In Fighting Sticks of Arnis we meet many grandmasters who are students of the founder of Modern Arnis, Professor Remy Presas. "I started in Modern Arnis" says grandmaster Rodel Dagooc. "Grandmaster Remy Presas was my godfather. Without him, Arnis would have become a dying art." For martial arts practitioners visiting the Philippines, Luneta Park is the first and last stop.

programme.title: Soldier Terminators aka American Force 4: Soldier Terminators
programme.desc: They destroy like an evil disease. The People's Freedom Army is a loosely knit army of South-east Asian patriots determined to protect their country from the communist threat. Infiltrating this organization is American agent Samson, who must deal with a subversive maniac, Roman Victor, who is trying to manipulate the PFA for his own evil purposes. The agents of destruction are the unseen enemy within.

programme.title: The Shaolin Kids
programme.desc: When a ruthless Premier Hu Wei Yung, writes a self-incriminating letter that ends up in the wrong hands (the delicate but deadly hands of the lovely Su Lin), he will stop at nothing to get it back. Premier kidnaps Miss Lin's father and she risks everything to free him.

programme.title: Los dos rivales
programme.desc: Los nombres de dos niños son cambiados al nacer, el niño recibe el nombre de su hermana y ella el de él.

programme.title: Dos locos en escena
programme.desc: El encargado de un teatro es asesinado para quitarle la nómina y su cadáver es escondido en un camerino.

programme.title: El Dolor de Pagar la Renta
programme.desc: Al ser desalojados dos ropavejeros de la vecindad, uno confiesa que guardó el dinero para curar a un niño enfermo.

programme.title: Cuidado con el amor
programme.desc: Un hombre que asiste a una feria local con su familia termina ganando una casa, pero, al inspeccionar el lugar, descubre que una mujer y su madre ya viven allí.

programme.title: El Circo de Capulina
programme.desc: Un ranchero va a visitar a su sobrina, Delia, a su trabajo en un circo, pero termina incorporándose al grupo como trapecista, malabarista y payaso.

programme.title: ¡Cómo hay gente sinvergüenza!
programme.desc: Una pareja de estafadores e impostores causan muchos problemas y risas.

programme.title: Capulina Contra los Monstruos
programme.desc: Un hombre vende revistas y al hacer una entrega es secuestrado por el dueño de una lúgubre mansión donde hay monstruos.

programme.title: Capulina vs Las Momias
programme.desc: Un taxista lleva hasta Guanajuato al sobrino de un científico que busca en las momias el secreto de la vida.

programme.title: Una carta de amor
programme.desc: Cuando va a ser fusilado, un militar lleva en su bolsillo una carta de amor de una joven que una vez lo ayudó a escapar.

programme.title: Tú y las Nubes
programme.desc: Una cantante española viaja a México y es asaltada por el camino, un charro la lleva a su hacienda y se enamora de ella.

programme.title: Tonta tonta, pero no tanto
programme.desc: Una mujer aborigen decide irse a vivir con una prima a la capital de México para encontrar un buen trabajo, pero no bien llega a la gran ciudad surgen toda clase de complicaciones.

programme.title: Si me han de matar mañana
programme.desc: La vida de un hombre cambia totalmente cuando encuentra a su hija, que había sido secuestrada años atrás por unos villanos.

programme.title: Sor Tequila
programme.desc: Una monja llega a un pueblo y tiene problemas con el sacerdote, debido a su comportamiento poco ortodoxo, pero, finalmente, ambos comprenden que persiguen el mismo fin: ayudar a las personas.

programme.title: Si Adelita se fuera con otro
programme.desc: Un rico ranchero se enamora de una soldadera, pero la familia de la chica no lo quiere por ser seguidor de Pancho Villa.

programme.title: Por la puerta falsa
programme.desc: Un hombre tiene en su poder la hipoteca de la hacienda de sus antiguos patrones y quiere casarse con la hija de ellos por la fuerza.

programme.title: Pobre, Pero Honrada
programme.desc: La india María vive en una cueva donde corre un manantial con el que prepara un brebaje que todos creen curativo.

programme.title: Paso a la juventud
programme.desc: Un estudiante de derecho destaca en una competencia de clavados y la hija del profesor de natación se enamora de él.

programme.title: Okey, Mister Pancho
programme.desc: Una indígena y su abuelo rescatan a un piloto herido de un avión que ha caído y descubren un cargamento de diamantes.

programme.title: No me defiendas compadre
programme.desc: Un hombre es acusado de robar unas llantas y su torpe abogado lo hunde más, pero una vecina le consigue trabajo.

programme.title: Me he de comer esa tuna
programme.desc: Un trío de simpáticos amigos se reencuentran después de muchos años. Han vuelto al pueblo para continuar con sus vidas y conocer a sus novias, pero sus fuertes bromas los llevarán por un divertido enredo que tendrán que resolver.

programme.title: Departamento de Soltero
programme.desc: Un médico traspasa su departamento de soltero a su amigo, engaña a su novia haciéndose pasar por él y se casa con otra.

programme.title: El sultán descalzo
programme.desc: Un vagabundo vive de hacer favores en una vecindad y finge ser profesor para darle clases de baile a una bella joven.

programme.title: Ella, Lucifer y yo
programme.desc: Un hombre hace un pacto con el diablo, para lograr el amor de una bellísima cantante.

programme.title: Muchachas que trabajan
programme.desc: Cuatro trabajadoras de una tienda enfrentan varias dificultades como un asesinato, chantajes y robos.

programme.title: ¡Ay pena, penita, pena!
programme.desc: En España, dos hermanos compran a una gitana un billete de lotería que resulta ganador y vuelven con ella a México.

programme.title: El camino de los espantos
programme.desc: Una tormenta impide que un grupo de personas prosiga su viaje por tren a la capital y continúan por un camino hechizado.

programme.title: Modern Hunter
programme.desc: Ride along with Wisconsin DNR Game Warden Jonathan Kaiser as he patrols the frozen waters of Lake Winnebago during the opening days of the state's historic sturgeon spearing season.

programme.title: Maxed Outdoors
programme.desc: YouTuber Braydon Price and his wife, Bri, come to Max's family ranch in South Texas to hunt with Max and Dante. Turkey season is in full go and the birds are fired up, allowing everyone to get a kill.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Can the everyday landowner really manage their property well enough to hold and retain mature bucks year after year? From habitat improvements and food plots to pressure control and property layout.

programme.title: The Next Bite
programme.desc: Jason Przekurat teams up with Nick Schertz to tackle northern Wisconsin lakes for BIG Walleyes with traditional tackle and forward facing sonar.
programme.sub-title: Mid Summer Big Walleye Beatdown In Northern Wisconsin.

programme.title: University of Fishing
programme.desc: Shallow water expert Drew Boggs Joins the crew as they skip docks for northern Largemouth.

programme.title: Fly Rod Chronicles
programme.desc: Last week on Fly Rod Chronicles we floated the Trough section of the South Branch of the Potomac River in search of small mouth bass.

programme.title: Seasons on the Fly
programme.desc: Traveling to Belize to pursue the myriad fish swimming in its shallow flats; an adventure off the coast of Placencia to chase bonefish, permit and snook.

programme.title: The High Road With Keith Warren
programme.desc: On this episode of The High Road with Keith Warren, Johnny Piazza is meeting up with Cameron from Longshot Target Cameras to hunt on his family Texas ranch for hogs, coyotes and deer.
programme.sub-title: Big Bucks, Huge Hogs and Crazy Coyotes

programme.title: Wiebe Trapline Adventures
programme.desc: Gage's numbers continue to climb today. It's been a terrific experience as he explains how he has grown as a muskrat trapper, the things he has learned, and how seasoned a trapper he has become in just 2 years since we were with him last.
programme.sub-title: Gage and Mark Spring Muskrat 2 of 2

programme.title: Innerloc's Outthere Stories
programme.desc: Brody and his dad head to Kansas to bow hunt for big whitetails. Brody is chasing a nice ten point buck named Spider.

programme.title: Shoot Straight TV
programme.desc: This week on Shoot Straight, Chad & Marsha Schearer are hunting mule deer in Montana. Chad heads to the high country and Marsha is out on the plains. Marsha is fixing a delicious Recipe from the Field featuring elk brats.

programme.title: McWhorter Rifles' Precision Hunting TV
programme.desc: Allan Rovig of McWhorter Custom Rifles travels to Kansas to hunt the early muzzleloader season with an MCR 45 XML.

programme.title: Deertopia
programme.desc: From site selection, access creation to deciding what to plant Steve Bartylla explains the steps that you should follow when starting a new food plot.

programme.title: Carnivore
programme.desc: A close up look at one Texas man's very first hunt with his brand new FREQ, the world's only true ultrasonic electronic caller.

programme.title: Hunting After Dark
programme.desc: Jason, Justin and Colt head to South Texas to help a rancher with his predator problems. No idea what they are going to encounter at night but the snake boots are on and gear is loaded.

programme.title: Dean Partridge's Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: Randy Kitts heads to Canadian Whitetail Outfitters in Northern Saskatchewan for a chance a at a multi-droptine nontypical bush buck with his bow.

programme.title: Live The Wild Life
programme.desc: Join the Live the Wild Life crew and friends as they explore Greenland in search of Musk Ox.

programme.title: Wallhanger Tv
programme.desc: Bow season opens in Kentucky with deer filling the fields. The crew faces heart-pounding near misses until Chad connects from the ground with his bow, setting the tone for the season.

programme.title: Weird Hunts
programme.desc: Matt creates a mule deer costume complete with a taxidermy mule deer head just as the Native Americans did to hunt down an animals in Wyoming. He encounters many problems along the way from otters to the weight of his costume.

programme.title: The American Way
programme.desc: Tony and Gary travel to Texas to hunt whitetails.
programme.sub-title: Texas Deer with Tony and Gary

programme.title: Conquest 200 - Life on a Family Deer Farm
programme.desc: Step behind the scenes of a working whitetail deer farm to discover the real story behind hunting scents. In Farm Chores, Doug Roberts of Conquest Scents reveals the surprising truth about deer urine collection-how it's regulated.

programme.title: Surviving Mann
programme.desc: The third episode of Wild Shots Season 1 is here!

programme.title: Maxed Outdoors
programme.desc: YouTuber Braydon Price and his wife, Bri, come to Max's family ranch in South Texas to hunt with Max and Dante. Turkey season is in full go and the birds are fired up, allowing everyone to get a kill.

programme.title: Yamaha's Whitetail Diaries
programme.desc: Our friends from TenPoint Crossbows come out to the Whitetail Diaries deer camp in Texas for a week of deer hunting, product testing to help reveal some new TenPoint Crossbows products and harvest some whitetail to fill the freezer.
programme.sub-title: Crossbow Deer Hunting With the all new 2025 Ten Point Turbo X

programme.title: For Love Or Likes
programme.desc: Things start to get heated as girls check trail cams and jealousy of daytime bucks start to set in. A competition with a twist causes chaos as girls compete to steal the best hunt zone and the first buck steps into shooting on the second evening.

programme.title: The Edge
programme.desc: Join the EDGE crew for the conclusion of their NZ adventure! After a successful red stag hunt, they pursue the Himalayan bull thar. With bad weather rolling in, unexpected plans make for a remarkable twist!

programme.title: Doug Koenig's Championship Season
programme.desc: Join Shooting Pro Doug Koenig as he hosts and shoots at the 2025 US Steel Nationals at the Titusville Rifle and Pistol club in Titusville, Florida. Team Ruger teammates Dave Olhasso and James McGinty are competing at the match as well.

programme.title: On The Road
programme.desc: On this episode the guys are at the Rio Bendita to kick off turkey season.

programme.title: Pursue The Wild
programme.desc: In this unforgettable episode of Pursue the Wild, I take you deep into a Wyoming antelope season that tested more than just skill or patience-it tested everything. From blistering 100- degree days spent in the blind.
programme.sub-title: From Ashes to Arrow: Wyoming Archery Antelope Hunting After Heat, Wildfire & Flood

programme.title: Target Rich Environment
programme.desc: From night-time thermal hog hunting to high-flying helicopter action, the crew takes on Texas pigs in every way possible - then wraps it up with the opening day of dove season in Avalon, where the skies come alive at first light.

programme.title: Red Arrow Tv
programme.desc: After drawing first blood on a big 7, Kip's daughter Izzie is taking her crossbow after a west Texas freezer queen and then it's Mom's turn! Kip's wife, Kat, has a big job taking care of their little band of savages but she is not just a great mom.
programme.sub-title: Momma Tried and Some Deer Died

programme.title: Saltwater Underground With Nick Honachefsky
programme.desc: Absolute tuna insanity off the Jersey Coast as Nick joins the crew of the Mushin and the Mama Tried for both day and night trips to chunk, troll and jig for yellowfin tuna.

programme.title: George Poveromo's World of Saltwater Fishing
programme.desc: George Poveromo targets flounder off North Carolina by jigging over local reefs and wrecks.
programme.sub-title: THE FLOUNDER TANGO, Wrightsville Beach, North Carolina!

programme.title: Sportsman's Adventures With Captain Rick Murphy
programme.desc: Capts. Rick and Ridge Murphy catch red snapper in Galveston, Texas with Capt. Karl Weston.

programme.title: Chasin The Sun
programme.desc: For Capt. Justin Leake, sight fishing the beach is one of the most productive, and FUN ways to fish. When that doesn't work, Capt. Todd Jones suggests fishing an artificial reef, and as it turns out, that's where dinner lives.
programme.sub-title: Beach for fun - Reef for flavor

programme.title: Goliath Fishing
programme.desc: Captain James Marko travels to Guatemala for a sailfish tournament and finds a deeper understanding of the conservation that's being conducted by the Guatemalan people.

programme.title: Uncharted Waters with Peter Miller
programme.desc: Peter Miller and his son Niles, along with Captains' Brandon Mullar and Garret Wade catch swordfish, queen snapper, almaco jack, mahi and tuna. After resting up at Hawks Cay they head down to Key West to visit the Papas Pilar rum distillery. PART 2.
programme.sub-title: Swordfish, Queen Snapper, Tuna, Almaco Jack and Mahi Mahi in the Florida Keys PART 2

programme.title: The Bassquatch Hunter Fish Out of Water
programme.desc: Kayak Fishing vs. Precision Farming Mike heads down to Texas A&M university to learn all about the science and technology behind precision farming with AgTech Logic. First Mike takes AgTech CEO Tom fishing for Texas catfish!

programme.title: Carolina All Out
programme.desc: Flounder fishing is a big deal in the South but the current restrictions on the Southern Flounder has the season closed for most of the year! We're hitting the backwaters of beautiful Cape Lookout for catch.

programme.title: Fly Rod Chronicles
programme.desc: Last week on Fly Rod Chronicles we floated the Trough section of the South Branch of the Potomac River in search of small mouth bass.

programme.title: Lindner's Angling Edge
programme.desc: James Lindner and Jake Wallace are in Sunset Country, Ontario, targeting walleye and pike using jigs rigged with soft plastics.

programme.title: Skeeter Bass Champs
programme.desc: The Skeeter Bass Champs host the first team tournament of the year at Sam Rayburn Revisor in very cold and windy conditions!

programme.title: Fishing And Hunting Texas
programme.desc: The Texas coast is full of locations for saltwater anglers to wet a line but two of the most famous areas are Baffin Bay and the Landcut where schools of trout and redfish roam. We join Wade Middleton and his longtime friend Chris Clarkson.
programme.sub-title: Fishing Baffin Bay and the Land Cut on a Windy Day

programme.title: Bass Pro Shop's Fisherman's Handbook
programme.desc: We spend time in this episode learning about bass fishing in low water and suggesting ways to maximize your time on the water, as well as tricks to try when the water is low and when the water goes back up.
programme.sub-title: Locating Bass When the Water is Low

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Can the everyday landowner really manage their property well enough to hold and retain mature bucks year after year? From habitat improvements and food plots to pressure control and property layout.

programme.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation
programme.desc: Heading to one of the great wilderness areas of North America, Dan Cabela is in search of Stone Sheep in British Columbia. Joining scientists, they embark on an ambitious conservation project to help conserve this incredible species.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: U.S. Army veteran Victoria Phillips shares her history of unimaginable trauma.

programme.title: Fisherman's Digest
programme.desc: John Bergsma showcases fishing hot spots in the Great Lakes region.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.desc: WE WILL TAKE YOU ON AN INCREDIBLE JOURNEY VISITING THE MOST ICONIC WRECKS AND REEFS IN THIS AREA OF THE KEYS. AND WE WILL ALSO EXPLORE THE GROUNDBREAKING WORK THAT SCIENTISTS AND VOLUNTEERS ARE WORKING ON TO SHADE CORALS FROM THE HARSH SUNLIGHT.

programme.title: Adventure Cities
programme.desc: Seasoned travel writer Jonathan Thompson sets out to explore the adventurous sides of Long Beach, Calif., and Alice Springs, Australia.

programme.title: Parks of the Palm Beaches
programme.desc: Seasons on the Fly travels to Belize to chase the many fish swimming the flats of this country. We are off the coast of a town called Placencia chasing Bonefish, permit and snook. Come join us for the adventure.

programme.title: Motorhead Garage
programme.desc: John Gardner explains parallelogram steering (and it's more interesting than it sounds), a studio guest shows off a better way to drive hands-free, and this week's Dream Car is a Nissan that's a true sleeper.
programme.sub-title: Parallelogram Steering, Footloose and Hands-Free, A Beautiful Skyline

programme.title: RV There Yet?
programme.desc: Patrice and Kevin McCabe hike and bike throughout the Tampa Bay area, tasting its history and staying at Hillsborough River State Park.

programme.title: Wallhanger Tv
programme.desc: Bow season opens in Kentucky with deer filling the fields. The crew faces heart-pounding near misses until Chad connects from the ground with his bow, setting the tone for the season.

programme.desc: Asking whether genes determine one's essential nature and identity, or one builds their own identity; exploring the essentialist and constructed philosophies; how one might incorporate aspects of both into their own view of personal identity.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: Labs that provide DNA ancestry information use hundreds of thousands of ancestry-information markers, or AIMs; learning about the AIMs that relate to major identifiable lineages; what can be gleaned from mitochondrial DNA and Y-DNA.
programme.sub-title: What Genetic Testing Brings to Ancestry

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: There are many social issues affecting an individual's emotional response to receiving DNA ancestry results; how the reciprocal engagement method can help families face unexpected ancestry results; tips to consider before ordering one's own test.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: People want a family narrative, whereas DNA just "wants" to move itself forward and is neutral on issues of race, subterfuge or social connection; how to create a strategic family narrative to incorporate the scientific facts of DNA ancestry results.
programme.sub-title: When Family Narrative Meets Genetic Testing

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: From the case of Henrietta Lacks to that of the Hagahai people of Papua New Guinea, scientists and government agencies have a history of bad actions with respect to biological samples; learning about the laws and programs in place to protect privacy.
programme.sub-title: Privacy Versus Connection in DNA Testing

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: Learning about the DNA Discussion Project and its goals; current results regarding the ways in which DNA ancestry tests are changing identity; looking at questions about unanticipated results, sharing DNA ancestry results and social implications.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: A genogram is a graphic tool used to explore family history and relationships over a two- to three-generation period; discovering the powerful information that can be conveyed through a genogram as opposed to the traditional family tree diagram.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: Exploring the issue of birth assisted by reproductive technologies by meeting Maria, who learns as a teenager that she was born with the help of intrauterine insemination; considering how this knowledge affect an adolescent's identity.

programme.title: The Return
programme.desc: Joanna Mills (Sarah Michelle Gellar) has a successful career but feels her personal life is spinning out of control. She has few friends, an estranged father (Sam Shepard), and a crazy ex-boyfriend who is stalking her. Joanna begins having terrifying visions of a woman's murder, and it seems that she is the killer's next target. Determined to solve the mystery and escape her apparent fate, Joanna follows her visions to the victim's hometown and finds that some secrets just do not stay buried.

programme.title: Mama
programme.desc: On the day that their parents die, sisters Lilly and Victoria vanish in the woods, prompting a frantic search by their Uncle Lucas (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) and his girlfriend, Annabel (Jessica Chastain). Five years later, miraculously, the girls are found alive in a decaying cabin, and Lucas and Annabel welcome them into their home. But as Annabel tries to reintroduce the children to a normal life, she finds that someone -- or something -- still wants to tuck them in at night.

programme.title: The Unborn
programme.desc: Plagued by nightmares and visitations from tortured ghosts, Casey Beldon (Odette Yustman) turns to a spiritual adviser named Sendak (Gary Oldman) for help. They discover a family curse that dates back to Nazi Germany: an evil spirit that can take over the body of anyone and is getting stronger with each possession, as it tries to gain full entrance to this world.

programme.title: White Noise 2: The Light
programme.desc: A man's family is killed, but he survives -- barely. After recovering, he realizes that he has changed in some way: He now senses when someone is about to die. In his attempts to save people who are near death, he discovers there is a price to pay for interfering with the cosmos.

programme.title: Whisper
programme.desc: Ex-con Max Truemont (Josh Holloway) is desperate for money so he can start a new life with his fiancee (Sarah Wayne Callies). When he is unable to secure the funds by ordinary means, he takes part in a plan to kidnap the young son of one of the state's wealthiest women. While awaiting instructions at their remote hideout, the kidnappers begin to turn on each other, and Max realizes that the boy may have a supernatural hand in the horrific events that follow.

programme.title: The New Daughter
programme.desc: A single father (Kevin Costner) is puzzled by his daughter's (Ivana Baquero) weird behavior, which begins soon after he moves his family to a secluded woodland home.

programme.title: Conan the Destroyer
programme.desc: In his second cinematic adventure, the mighty warrior Conan (Arnold Schwarzenegger) is tricked into working for the scheming Queen Taramis (Sarah Douglas). Along with finding a mystical horn, Conan and his allies, which include the fierce fighter, Zula (Grace Jones), and the wisecracking sorcerer, Akiro (Mako), must protect the beautiful young Princess Jehnna (Olivia d'Abo). With deception and danger at every turn, Conan has to use all of his power to defeat the evil foes that stand in his way.

programme.title: The Truth About Charlie
programme.desc: Regina (Thandie Newton) meets charming Joshua (Mark Wahlberg) while vacationing in Martinique, as she contemplates ending her whirlwind marriage to enigmatic Charlie (Stephen Dillane). Then upon her return to Paris, she finds that both her apartment and her bank account have been emptied, and her husband has been murdered. The more Reggie learns, the more she realizes the scope of the puzzle, which she must solve to protect herself from ever-increasing danger.

programme.title: Breach
programme.desc: Eric O'Neill (Ryan Phillippe), a low-level surveillance expert with the FBI, believes he is accomplishing his dream of becoming a full-fledged agent, with his unexpected promotion and assignment to work with renowned agent Robert Hanssen (Chris Cooper). However, he soon learns the reason for his promotion is to gain Hanssen's trust and find proof that he is a traitor to the country.

programme.title: Devil
programme.desc: Five strangers' day begins with an elevator ride in a Philadelphia office tower. But, what happens next is anything but ordinary. The elevator gets stuck, and the trapped passengers, who expected to be together just a few minutes, now face the revelation of their secrets and transgressions. Frightening events turn annoyance into terror, as they begin to realize that one of their number is Lucifer himself.

programme.title: My Soul to Take
programme.desc: In the small town of Riverton, a local legend tells of a serial killer's oath to come back and kill the seven children who were born on the night he supposedly died. Now 16 years later, Riverton residents are disappearing again, making some wonder if the legend is true. Bug (Max Thieriot), plagued by nightmares all his life, is one of the so-called Riverton Seven, and it's up to him to save his friends from an evil that will not rest.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Ma
programme.desc: A lonely middle-aged woman befriends some teenagers and decides to let them party in the basement of her home. But there are some house rules: One of the kids has to stay sober, don't curse, and never go upstairs. They must also refer to her as Ma. But as Ma's hospitality starts to curdle into obsession, what began as a teenage dream turns into a terrorizing nightmare, and Ma's place goes from the best place in town to the worst place on Earth.

programme.title: Seven in Heaven
programme.desc: A 16-year-old discovers all of his fears are true.

programme.title: Unfriended
programme.desc: One night, while teenagers Blaire, Mitch, Jess, Adam Ken and Val take part in an online group chat session, they are suddenly joined by a user known only as "Billie227." Thinking it's just a technical glitch, the friends carry on their conversation... until Blaire begins receiving messages from someone claiming to be Laura Barns, a classmate who killed herself exactly one year prior. As Blaire tries to expose Billie's identity, her friends are forced to confront their darkest secrets and lies.

programme.title: Unfriended: Dark Web
programme.desc: After finding a laptop, a young man goes online to play a game with five of his good friends. He shows them a mysterious folder that plays disturbing videos of people who appear to be in danger. They then receive an anonymous message that tells them they will all die if they disconnect or call the police. The planned night of fun quickly turns deadly as each user becomes the target of something sinister while the others watch helplessly in terror.

programme.title: ffolkes
programme.desc: An English admiral (James Mason) needs an eccentric lord (Roger Moore) and his frogmen to save oil rigs and a ship from a mad bomber (Anthony Perkins).
